title: Europa-Park
description: Europa-Park is an amusement park in Rust, Germany, opened in 1975. Its lands and areas include Germany, France, Italy, Switzerland, Greece, Spain, Iceland, Ireland, Scandinavia, Austria, Netherlands, Portugal, England, Russia, Luxembourg. Among its operating rides are Silver Star (thrill coaster); Blue Fire Megacoaster (thrill coaster); Wodan: Timburcoaster (thrill coaster); Voltron Nevera (thrill coaster); Euro-Mir (thrill coaster). Europe in miniature: each land is a European country, with architecture, food and rides matched to that country. Europa-Park is Germany's largest theme park and a multi-day resort, with hotels and a water park beside the main park. The historic castle park at the centre and the quieter country gardens are calmer than the coaster plazas.
